findings.title: Validate push.data.module before write to notification.data
findings.rationale: notificationclick filters URL via ALLOWED_NOTIFICATION_MODULES, but postMessage({type: 'OPEN_MODULE', module: payload.module}) on sw.ts:69 is NOT filtered. Adversary push payload can postMessage arbitrary module string into SPA message handler.
findings.remediation: Apply ALLOWED_NOTIFICATION_MODULES.has(payload.module) to data.module before assignment, or pass already-validated const from sw.ts:56.

findings.title: Add aria-modal + aria-labelledby + useDialogFocusTrap to 4 hand-rolled dialogs
findings.rationale: These dialogs declare role='dialog' or role='alertdialog' but omit aria-modal, aria-labelledby, and any focus-trap hook. Screen reader users get trapped; all keyboard input is intercepted.
findings.remediation: Add aria-modal='true', aria-labelledby pointing to title id, and useDialogFocusTrap. Wire apps/web/src/test/helpers/expectDialogA11y.ts:4-60 into unit tests.

findings.title: Wire /offline route + add to OFFLINE_SHELL_CANDIDATES
findings.rationale: OfflinePage is @scaffolded with @nextStep instructions in file header but not registered in router; SW setCatchHandler returns precached index.html which boots SPA without 'you're offline' UX.
findings.remediation: Register /offline in StandaloneRoutes.tsx; add to OFFLINE_SHELL_CANDIDATES. Drop the @scaffolded/@nextStep tags.

findings.title: Add in-app language switcher UI
findings.rationale: useLocale().setLocale is exposed but never wired to any UI control. Users have no in-app way to switch language; only ?lang= URL parameter (set by external marketing link) toggles it.
findings.remediation: Add a LocaleSwitcher control in GeneralSection or HubSettingsPage with setLocale handler. Persist to localStorage[sergeant:locale].

findings.title: Leaf-level key-parity test (en vs uk) — EN catalog 9 keys short
findings.rationale: EN catalog has 354 leaf keys vs UK 363. Current test locks only top-level group shape, not leaf coverage. EN silently falls through to UK for any missing leaf inside a declared group.
findings.remediation: Add keysDeepEqual(messagesEn, uk) test (or build-time codegen). Iterate EN to 363 keys.

findings.title: memo(TxRow) — 598 LOC, no memo wrapper
findings.rationale: Used in Finyk transactions list. Without memo, re-renders on every setTransactions/scroll event. Highest-impact perf gap in hot list.

findings.title: Add ExpirationPlugin to navigations NetworkFirst
findings.rationale: navigations-v<build> has no ExpirationPlugin. Every visited URL persists until build bump. PWA sessions living weeks accumulate dozens of stale entries.

findings.title: Add CacheFirst for /assets/, /icon-* + image hosts
findings.rationale: No CacheFirst/StaleWhileRevalidate for images, fonts, static assets. Orphan google-fonts-css/google-fonts-woff references in clearAppCaches:228-229 but nothing populates them.

findings.title: Dialog-interaction E2E pass (axe + focus trap + Esc + focus restore)
findings.rationale: test:a11y scans closed DOM only. No Sheet/Modal/Popover/Dropdown/CommandPalette is opened during axe scan; focus-trap, aria-modal, inert behavior unverified.

findings.title: Differentiate <nav> and <header> landmarks with aria-label
findings.rationale: Multiple <nav> in same DOM trip axe landmark-unique. HubHeader and HubBottomNav lack distinguishing labels.

findings.title: Add apple-touch-startup-image + apple-mobile-web-app-title
findings.rationale: iOS PWA cold-start flashes white before first paint because no startup image declared. <title> is 47 chars; iOS uses it instead of truncated short_name for home-screen label.

findings.title: Land LCP tightening PR (3000 ms warn → error)
findings.rationale: Current LCP threshold 3000 ms equals the planned error level. Regression to 3001 ms logs warning but passes workflow. Tightening flips gate to error and adds branch-protection.

findings.title: Remove DM Sans fallback font (saves woff2 + CSS)
findings.rationale: DM Sans is the legacy fallback kept 'until PR-8 polish decides'. Removing saves one variable woff2 + matching CSS @font-face block.

findings.title: Tighten Workbox pin ~7.4.0 (caret allows minor bumps)
findings.rationale: Caret pin allows minor bumps that change precache hashes. Byte-exact precache stability risk.

findings.title: Verify tree-shaking of en.ts via build:analyze; dynamic-import per-locale if not
findings.rationale: shared/i18n/uk.ts (869 LOC) + en.ts (639 LOC) eagerly pulled by main.tsx:39. EN is only used when locale is en. Tree-shaking may not drop messagesEn because index re-exports it.

findings.title: Currency formatter locale-aware (formatMoney ignores useLocale)
findings.rationale: formatMoney always uses 'uk-UA' regardless of useLocale(). EN visitor sees '1 250 ₴' instead of '1 250 UAH' (or '₴1,250'). Entry point for multi-currency paywall promise.

findings.title: <html lang> runtime-sync via useLayoutEffect
findings.rationale: apps/web/index.html:2 hard-codes lang='uk'; apps/web/src/shared/lib/ui/export.ts:140 same. No useEffect updates it to match resolved locale. Screen readers, search crawlers, browser translation prompt all see lang='uk' for EN visitors.

findings.title: Decompose FinykApp.tsx (620) and NutritionApp.tsx (623) under Hard Rule #18
findings.rationale: Both exceed 600-line max-lines cap. God-orchestrators mounting 8-15 hooks + 5-8 local useState. RoutineApp.tsx (109 LOC) decomposition (initiative 0001 Phase 2) is the template.

findings.title: Verify useMemo on HubShellProvider value
findings.rationale: HubShellContext (core/app/HubShellContext.tsx:24-64) carries 21 fields. If RootLayout doesn't useMemo the value prop, every state change in 12+ side-effect hooks re-renders the entire hub.

findings.title: De-duplicate dual-write boot (RootLayout + modules)
findings.rationale: useNutritionDualWriteBoot + useNutritionSqliteReadBoot called both in RootLayout.AuthenticatedNutritionBoot and NutritionApp. Same for Fizruk. If hooks are not idempotent, event listeners double and risk leaks on module unmount.

findings.title: Move FinanceCard/FitnessCard/NutritionCard/ExpensesCard from core/hub/ to modules/<m>/hubCard/
findings.rationale: Module-specific dashboard cards live in core/hub/ which violates the symmetric principle of Hard Rule #12. Move to modules/<m>/hubCard/ to tighten the containment story.

findings.title: useApiForm rollout completion (auth/profile/pricing/finyk/fizruk/routine)
findings.rationale: Barrel @scaffolded; auth/profile/pricing/finyk/fizruk/routine form call-sites still deep-import useApiForm. Pattern solid; rollout incomplete.

findings.title: EN pluralization + hreflang SEO infra
findings.rationale: pluralTimes/pluralDays/pluralUa are UA-only. EN catalog has no one/other variants. Count-bearing EN strings render ungrammatical. No <link rel='alternate' hreflang='uk|en'> SEO infrastructure.

findings.title: Vitest coverage firing validation errors + asserting aria-invalid + aria-describedby
findings.rationale: No Vitest test fires validation errors and asserts aria-invalid='true' + aria-describedby → role='alert' on errors. Module forms hand-roll inputs and risk breaking the contract.

findings.title: VisuallyHidden primitive + useLiveRegion hook (consolidate sr-only)
findings.rationale: 27 files write sr-only independently with slight variations. Centralize as VisuallyHidden wrapper (with as prop) + useLiveRegion('polite'|'assertive') hook.

findings.title: Rename dashboardStore.ts → dashboardOrderStorage.ts
findings.rationale: 34 LOC but exports are loadDashboardOrder/saveDashboardOrder/resetDashboardOrder + re-export of webKVStore. Not a state store; it's a KV adapter. Rename to avoid future confusion.

findings.title: pruneOldNotifiedKeys should also fire on SW boot, not only from checkReminders
findings.rationale: pruneOldNotifiedKeys called only from checkReminders (reminders.ts:219). If *_STATE_UPDATE messages never arrive, IDB Set grows unbounded.

findings.title: Switch sm 36×20 → pointer-coarse bump to 44×44
findings.rationale: sm track 36×20 < 44×44 hit-area on touch. md is 44×26 — only long edge meets 44.

findings.title: Add aria-label to sync status pills (HubChatHeader, SyncStatusBadge, SyncIndicator)
findings.rationale: 8/5/4 colour hits respectively. May rely solely on colour to convey sync state — needs manual color-blind review (deuteranopia + protanopia).

findings.title: Manifest completeness (categories, screenshots, id, scope, display_override)
findings.rationale: Missing: categories, id, scope, prefer_related_applications=false, display_override, screenshots, launch_handler, handle_links, protocol_handlers, share_target, file_handlers.

findings.title: iOS PWA format-detection telephone=no
findings.rationale: Phone-number auto-linking not suppressed. iOS Safari may auto-link numbers in transaction lists (Finyk).

hard_rules_compliance.rule_12_module_accent_containment: WARN: FinanceCard/FitnessCard/NutritionCard/ExpensesCard in core/hub/ violate symmetric containment
